acceptanceCriteria: A test or benchmark times widen and reap with one writer on segmented 10k and 40k stores
It records host load next to each result and labels results unqualified above load 12
body: Lane journal-1021h (PR #1454, V1-2202 S6a) measured widen and reap only under TestCALV0263, which has 6-15 concurrent writers on a loaded host. Expected: a single-writer harness that times widen/reap on a 10k and a 40k segmented store and reports p50/p95, so S6a and S6b gains are measurable. Actual: the only figures are contended runs at load 16-75.
title: tests: no single-writer (B3) harness for widen/reap latency, so the JSG resume path's speed-up cannot be measured without writer contention
